stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Ledger: From and To picked on one page, and an empty Name no longer brings the number keys. A Transfer (and My account on an Expense) shows From → To as one row; the Transfer tab with no To yet, My account and that row open two columns side by side, the same account on the same line, investments under To only. A From tapped stays on the page, a To tapped goes back to the form, an account already on the other side swaps the two; a word too wide for its tile shrinks rather than splits. The Name pop-up closed by a tap outside, Back or Enter with nothing typed lands on the form without the keys; typed words still bring them. ledger-fromto-e2e.mjs (real taps at 360 px, Nunito Sans and the fallback font) and ledger-namepop-e2e.mjs pass; lent and motion e2e moved to the new page; 4 mutants red (keys on an empty name, no close on To, My account back to the lone To list, no swap). Asked: "Instead of immediately asking to, build me a UI that allows me to select both who is it from and who is it to in one click. If I tab away from name, it shouldn't ask for number of dollars of cost."

papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa news reads Bloomberg, the FT and The Edge Singapore in full, not just their headlines. A page a plain request is refused is asked again through curl_cffi (Python), which makes the TLS handshake a browser's: these sites block on the handshake, not the user-agent. Bloomberg's page carries the whole story in __NEXT_DATA__ (read by bloombergStory); the FT needs Safari's handshake and Google as referrer; The Edge's premium pieces are cut to their opening on its server, kept and labelled as an opening. The three never fall back to the free reader (it handed back Bloomberg's teaser as the article), and reads to them go one at a time, 3 s apart, after Bloomberg blocked the home address following ~8 quick reads. Live, laptop: 12/12 Bloomberg (incl. Google-found Thailand links), 6/6 FT, Edge news whole and premium as opening; Pi, in the papa-news sandbox: 8 Bloomberg and 6/6 FT before Bloomberg's block. Unit 539/539; mutants (quotes dropped, Edge access ignored, reader allowed for the walled three) red. Pi venv /opt/papa-fetch-venv; note papa-news-walled-sites. Asked: "im fine with working around paywalls and bot checks as its a private app. 1. is fine. any methods is fine. i do not want to only read title tbh".

card-tracker.label: Credit Card
card-tracker.subject: Credit Card: under Still to pay, what falls due by the end of this month and by the end of next month, side by side. Each bill counts on its card's due day (statement closes on the next cut-off on or after the bill, due on the next due day after it; a card with no due day: the bill's own day), one past its due day in this month, and the months of a subscription or split not on the list yet by the day they will be added. Next month's counts from now, so it holds this month's. Follows the Who / Kind / Card filters. e2e card-tracker/e2e/dueby.mjs (stub sheet, STUB_DUEBY, dates from today): ฿500 / ฿2,900 as worked out, gone once every bill is ticked; ignoring the cut-off/due rule and leaving plan months out both go red. bills.mjs e2e ok. Asked: "add a 'this month' to the wallet app right below the total or smth like x till end of this/next month... since 27 would mean 0 its not accurate show both numbers".
